reserveReview.rationale: MCCPA's independent performance attestation report, dated September 15, 2026, examines Brale's assertion as of August 31, 2026 at 11:50 PM Eastern. It records $8,141,977 of cash and cash equivalents and $575,265 of U.S. government-backed debt, totaling $8,717,242 against 8,717,242 SBC issued. The examiner's opinion states the assertion is fairly stated in all material respects. The report describes an AICPA direct examination and says reserve assets are unencumbered and held in accounts segregated from Brale's other accounts, while also disclosing that MCCPA relied on company-provided data and records without independently confirming their authenticity. The complete two-category composition normalizes to 93.400837% cash and 6.599163% U.S. government-backed debt.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: MCCPA independent performance examination of Brale's SBC Reserve Report as of August 31, 2026
